sections.title: One-Click Measurement
sections.tabSummary: What automated Peltier temperature control removes
body: Learn how automated Peltier temperature control removes manual correction from every reading on the Mettler Toledo Excellence R4.

Refractive index and Brix readings shift with temperature, which normally means either measuring at a fixed reference temperature every time, or correcting each reading manually afterward. Both routes cost time, and both introduce a place for human error to creep in.

Excellence R4 holds the sample at a controlled temperature automatically, accurate to ±0.1°C, across its working range. Combined with the 7" touchscreen interface, a measurement becomes genuinely one click: place the sample, press measure, read the temperature-corrected result directly.

body: Learn what the integrated sugar tables on the Mettler Toledo MyBrix actually cover.

Different beverage and food industries measure sugar content in different units, entirely by convention rather than any technical necessity. A winemaker thinks in °Baumé or Oechsle, a brewer in °Plato, a syrup producer in HFCS grades. MyBrix carries all of them built in, so switching between a vineyard reading and a syrup QC check doesn't mean switching instruments or doing conversion math by hand.
